text: Guided 60 or 90 minute Contrast Therapy Sessions (Rotating between Finnish Sauna & Ice bath)
Experience the powerful benefits of alternating heat and cold. Sessions include guided rotations between Finnish barrel sauna (80 to 100 degrees Celsius) and ice bath immersion.
Reduces muscle soreness (DOMS), perceived fatigue, and improves subjective recovery (first 24 to 72h post-exercise). (Xiao et al., 2023; Machado et al., 2016)
Contrast therapy reduces post-exercise fatigue and soreness, enhancing perceived recovery. (Machado et al., 2016; Higgins et al., 2017)
May reduce post-exercise inflammation and markers of muscle damage; timing, temperature, and duration matter. (Bleakley et al., 2012; Machado et al., 2016)
Can improve mood, reduce stress, and enhance well-being; benefits similar for women. (Knechtle et al., 2020; Higgins et al., 2017)
